title: Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan directs APPCB to initiate action against Andhra Paper Limited for ‘polluting’ Godavari river
description: Official statistics confirm that half of the pollution in Rajamahendravaram city comes from the APL, he says in a post on X, while referring to the alleged evasion of ₹21.34 crore tax by the company to the local bodies since 2016
